acceptanceCriteria: Every one of the 7 P0 task checkboxes in impl-plans/active/work-runtime-p0-model-and-store.md is checked with concrete per-box evidence recorded in the plan progress log.
A new SwiftPM target RielaWork exists with RielaWorkTests, depends on RielaCore and RielaSQLite, and RielaCore contains zero occurrences of 'import RielaWork' proven by a test.

The domain model from design section 4 is implemented with closed enums and strict decoding (an unknown enum value is a decode error), with round-trip tests and checked-in fixture JSON under Tests/RielaWorkTests/Fixtures.

WorkStore creates work_intents, work_tasks, work_attempts, work_decisions, work_evidence and work_findings in the runtime records database with the documented columns, indexes, optimistic concurrency on work_tasks.version, and a schema generation guard that discards a mismatched store.

WorkEvidenceProjector projects a persisted WorkflowRuntimePersistenceSnapshot into Evidence and Finding records with causedBy edges as in design section 8, and CompletionEvaluator implements the design section 5 rule as a pure function including the gate payload acceptance.met check.

riela task show <taskId> and riela task list work read-only with json, jsonl and text output following the LoopCommands rendering, resolving the store root through canonicalRuntimeStoreRoot, and their SurfaceCatalog rows are updated from blocked to their real state with the other surfaces still declared.

A test runs the two loop example workflows with their mock scenarios, projects the terminal snapshots into a task each, and asserts gate, finding, verification and cost counts against EXPECTED_RESULTS.md.

arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc 'swift build && swift test' at the worktree root reports no failures beyond the ten accepted environmental ones listed in the constraints, and SwiftLint is clean on changed sources.
All work is committed on feat/work-runtime-p0 and pushed to that branch only; main and feat/control-surface-parity are untouched.
